title: KS3 review quiz (25 marks)
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Review of Key Stage 3 and working scientifically (9C)
source: Written for science/y9 lesson 58 (KS3 review quiz (25 marks) and mark scheme (portal))
intro: Lesson 58. 25 minutes. Mixed Key Stage 3 questions; your results set your Summer 2 repair list.

questions.q: A wave has speed 340 m/s and frequency 170 Hz. Find the wavelength.
What sets the pitch of a sound?
Which travels faster, light or sound?
Name the process plants use to make glucose.
Image 30 mm, magnification × 100. Find the real size.
Write the word equation for anaerobic respiration in muscles.
Name the part of the blood that fights infection.
How many atoms are in CaCO₃?
Describe the test for carbon dioxide.
questions.a: Bubble through limewater (1); it turns milky (1)

questions.q: What is made when an acid reacts with an alkali?
Why do Group 1 metals react in similar ways?
questions.a: They have the same number of outer electrons (one)

questions.q: A 500 N force acts on 0.25 m². Find the pressure.
Find the resultant of 50 N forward and 20 N backward.
A 60 W lamp is on for 2 hours. Energy in kWh?
Which surface absorbs infrared radiation best: matt black or shiny silver?
Explain why a metal spoon in hot water feels hot to touch.
questions.a: Metals are good conductors (1); particles pass on vibrations quickly (1)

questions.q: Name the type of error caused by a balance that reads 2 g with nothing on it.

questions.a: To spot anomalies and reduce random error (and find a mean)
